Wrote a multithreaded Monte Carlo path tracer in C++ with a BVH acceleration structure and tile-parallel rendering

Profiled frame time with the Unity Profiler and removed GC allocations from the hot path
Implemented client-side prediction and server reconciliation for player movement on a 5-person team
